notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Saber Ants indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Saber Ants.
description:
Give Saber Ants indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Saber Ants.
Saber Ants triggers, creating at least one 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge, causing the Insect to deal one damage to Saber Ants.
Repeat from step 3.
